title: Now the Light Has Gone Away
description: Now the Light Has Gone Away in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Frances Ridley Havergal, first published in 1869. The tune, MÜDE BIN ICH, GEH ZUR RUH, is from Liederbuch für Kleinkinder-Schulen, 1842. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Now the light has gone a-way; Fa-ther, lis-ten while I pray, Ask-ing Thee to watch and keep And to send me qui-et sleep.

lines: Now the light has gone away;
Father, listen while I pray,
Asking Thee to watch and keep
And to send me quiet sleep.
Jesus, Savior, wash away
All that has been wrong today;
Help me every day to be
Good and gentle, more like Thee.
Let my near and dear ones be
Always near and dear to Thee.
Oh, bring me and all I love
To Thy happy home above.
Now my evening praise I give;
Thou didst die that I might live.
All my blessings come from Thee;
Oh, how good Thou art to me!
Thou, my best and kindest Friend,
Thou wilt love me to the end.
Let me love Thee more and more,
Always better than before.
